errors.evidence: The description states the data covers the period 1995-2018, but the first category on the chart is "1990-1995", so the data starts from 1990.
This is a horizontal bar chart, so the vertical axis contains the categories (time periods), and the horizontal axis contains the values (percentages).
When listing the categories, the description omits the first one shown on the chart, which is "1990-1995".
For a horizontal bar chart, the value is represented by the length of the bars, not their height.

errors.evidence: This description of the order of the bars is incorrect and self-contradictory.
